metadata.dcterms:abstract: )1 Kathrin Figl2, Jan Mendling3, Gul Tokdemir4, Jan Vanthienen5 Abstract: The recent Decision Model and Notation (DMN) establishes business decisions as first- class citizens of executable business processes. This research note has two objectives: first, to describe DMN’s technical and theoretical foundations; second, to identify research directions for investigating DMN’s potential benefits on a technological, individual and organizational level. To this end, we integrate perspectives from management science, cognitive theory and information systems research.
